content.text: Digital creators worldwide face significant barriers when it comes to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-ebooks-nigeria-without-paypal-what-nobody-tells-8|selling]] products online, especially in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or impose high fees. For instance, creators in countries like Nigeria or Venezuela often find themselves limited to basic solutions that charge excessive commissions. This breakdown will illustrate how crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you-4|COREMERCH guide to payment]] gateways can empower creators to sell digital products without the traditional constraints. By [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-plain-language-8|Understanding Selling]] the architecture behind these systems, you can keep more of your earnings while maintaining full control over your business operations.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway for digital products is a system that allows creators to accept payments in cryptocurrency, enabling them to bypass traditional banking restrictions and fees. Unlike conventional platforms that charge steep commissions—such as Gumroad’s 10% on each sale—NOWPayments only charges a minimal 0.5%. This difference can significantly impact profitability. For example, selling 100 units of a $97 ebook through Gumroad would result in $921 less for the creator compared to using NOWPayments. Understanding this infrastructure is crucial for maximizing revenues and retaining ownership of your digital assets.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment gateway involves several components working together seamlessly. At its core, the system utilizes blockchain technology to process transactions securely and quickly. When a customer makes a purchase, their payment is verified on-chain without the need for a traditional banking intermediary. This means instant payment confirmation and automatic product delivery, typically achieved through automation tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. By leveraging free hosting options and open-source tools, you can build a resilient and efficient digital commerce stack that remains entirely under your control.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms impose restrictions or exorbitant fees. Whether you’re an ebook author in Ghana, a course creator in Kenya, or a software developer in Bangladesh, this solution gives you the freedom to sell your products without the burden of third-party control or high processing costs. The architecture enables creators to maintain ownership of their data, ensuring that everything from customer interactions to sales records remains in your hands, empowering you to scale your business independently.
NOWPayments charges just 0.5%, significantly less than platforms that take up to 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this eco-system include a reliable hosting platform, a backend for order processing, and a payment gateway for crypto transactions. For hosting, options like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are cost-effective and user-friendly. For backend logic, tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automate processes such as order fulfillment. On the payments front, NOWPayments facilitates crypto transactions, offering a wide range of supported currencies with minimal fees. Together, these elements create a robust infrastructure that allows for an efficient and sovereign digital commerce operation.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start leveraging this infrastructure, first select your hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up backend automation with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing. Integrate NOWPayments for your crypto transactions, ensuring automatic payment verification. Load your digital products, whether they're ebooks, courses, or software, and configure delivery settings. With this framework, you're ready to accept payments, take control of your sales, and maximize profitability. For a complete toolkit, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the necessary blueprints and templates for effective deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This system allows for direct crypto transactions, enabling you to keep more of your earnings without the heavy fees associated with traditional platforms. By using free hosting and backend solutions, you can fully control your sales and inventory.
Full ownership of your customer data means no one can hold your sales hostage.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re looking to sell digital downloads exclusively using cryptocurrencies, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a comprehensive solution. It includes all six blueprints and seven templates you need to build and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore the offerings at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can use a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments, which allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies. This system bypasses traditional banking restrictions and offers minimal fees, ensuring you retain more of your earnings.

Leverage a sovereign digital commerce stack that includes free hosting solutions and a crypto payment gateway. This architecture reduces reliance on traditional platforms and their associated fees, allowing you to keep the majority of your sales revenue.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, by using a crypto payment gateway and hosting your products on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your audience without incurring Gumroad or Payhip fees.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. This flexibility allows you to cater to a global audience and tap into various crypto markets, enhancing your sales potential.
How can I automate delivery of my digital products?

You can automate the delivery of your digital products using tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools facilitate instant product delivery upon payment confirmation, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
